messages:
carmen: Quick heads-up — found some canary request logs that include partially visible bearer tokens. tagging security. need a fast scope + comms decision.

evans: @carmen can you paste an example (mask any remaining bits) and say where exactly? staging/canary/prod?

carmen: staging-canary cluster, logs from the ingest worker. about 30 lines. example (sanitized):\n```
INFO 2026-03-10 14:21:03 request_id=abc123 auth=\"Bearer abc12345...\" route=/v1/generate
```
The token shows first 8 chars then `...` because our string truncate happens after 8 chars.

ria: are these customer tokens or internal service tokens?

carmen: internal test harness tokens only — we confirm no real customer tokens. they live in the canary env.

sam: I ran `rg "Bearer [A-Za-z0-9]{4,}" -n /var/logs/prod || true` against prod and found nothing. staging only.

security-eng: thanks for pinging. two quick asks: 1) sample log (you gave), 2) retention window for those logs (how long before rotated/archived), 3) are any backups containing them?

carmen: retention for canary logs is 7 days, backups are nightly for prod only (canary excluded). no backups contain them.

security-eng: ok. preliminary assessment: low severity since tokens are internal and truncated. still recommend rotating the impacted service tokens and patching logging immediately. do you have a PR/patch ready?

carmen: opened PR #4321 to sanitize the header logging (replace token with `<redacted>`). deploying to canary now. rollout plan: deploy to canary -> validate 15m -> deploy to staging. will not touch prod.

evan: please include the exact grep command you used and the PR link in the incident ticket so we can audit later.

carmen: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/ingest/pulls/4321
grep used: `rg "Authorization: Bearer" -n /srv/ingest/logs | head -30`

ria: after deploy, rotate the test harness tokens. security-eng: can we do an automated rotate so nothing lingers?

security-eng: yes, we can rotate the test tokens. assign to @sam to run rotate script and confirm rotation in the thread.

sam: will do. ETA 30m after PR merged. I'll post the rotate logs (sanitized) here.

carmen: deploy complete to canary, no errors in health checks. validating logs for new redaction now.

sam: rotation done. rotated token IDs: th-9876 -> rotated. (I won't paste tokens).

ria: quick comms question: do we need external customer notification or press? my read: no — internal only, no prod exposure. security-eng, pls confirm.

security-eng: agreed: no external notification required. action items: 1) patch merged (PR 4321), 2) tokens rotated, 3) add entry to infra incident log, 4) update logging runbook to enforce redaction. tagging severity: `privacy-low`. :white_check_mark:

carmen: filing infra incident with summary + timeline now. link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0310-07

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0310-07 created and set to `monitoring`. Assigned: carmen, sam. (automated)

carmen: follow-up: will add a short bullet in next weekly infra update so product/customer-facing teams are aware it's contained and fixed. closing thread here unless someone needs more.

ria: :eyes: thanks all — adding note to runbook.

security-eng: closing approval: no external comms, postmortem internal. keep ticket open until next weekly triage.
